metadata.title: When you finally get a kill and the enemy instantly questions reality
metadata.description:
Wait, did that just happen? Enemy probably fooled themselves.
Valorant giving me freebies like it’s charity day.
Click if your best kills look like a glitch in the matrix.

Tap if your aim’s more ‘oops’ than ‘pro’!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #shorts #funnygaming
